plan.what: Round-2 exam plan (PREREG section 7). Read by exam2.py; its sha256 is written into the exam-2 lock file.
plan.per_arm_comparators: ratchet.json compare_to of each round-2 arm (family b2 arm -> its v1.0 arm; E1 -> its best dev member; E2 -> E1)
plan.rule: paired bootstrap over basins of the difference in medians, 10,000 resamples, default_rng(20261118); win/loss only when the 95 % interval excludes 0

ens_e1.label: E1: equal-weight ensemble of the five v1.0 tied arms

compute.notes: No training: the five members are the registered v1.0 arms, unchanged. Dev + sim-val evaluation 11 CPU-min.

ens_e1.feature_engineering: None of its own: each member reads the batch as in round 1. Combination per target day, weights 1/5: mean of the members' means; each quantile = mean of the members' same quantile, then sorted.

ens_e1_conformal.label: E1: equal-weight ensemble of the five v1.0 tied arms + Mondrian conformal

compute.notes: conformal fit only on dev predictions of ens_e1

ens_e1_conformal.feature_engineering: none beyond ens_e1's; the offset uses static[11] and the class list (strata)

ens_e2.label: E2: equal-weight ensemble of the five round-2 entries

compute.notes: No training of its own: members are tab_gbm_b2, flowcast_v1, seq_lstm_b2, seq_tcn_b2, seq_ssm_b2 (registered). Dev + sim-val evaluation 11 CPU-min.

ens_e2.feature_engineering: None of its own: each member reads the batch as registered. Combination per target day, weights 1/5: mean of the members' means; each quantile = mean of the members' same quantile, then sorted.

ens_e2_conformal.label: E2: equal-weight ensemble of the five round-2 entries + Mondrian conformal

compute.notes: conformal fit only on dev predictions of ens_e2

ens_e2_conformal.feature_engineering: none beyond ens_e2's; the offset uses static[11] and the class list (strata)
